color.$description: Sun-washed plaster and kiln terracotta by day, roasted espresso and sunlit clay by night: a warm palette facet that composes over any design language without touching its space or type.

surface-raised.$description: Chalk glaze: the sheet above the page.

text.$description: Roasted espresso: the primary reading ink.

border-strong.$description: Glazed rim: a control's own edge.

primary.$description: Kiln terracotta: primary actions, readable as text on plaster and behind white ink as a fill.

on-primary.$description: The ink on the primary fill.

on-secondary.$description: The ink on the secondary fill.

on-accent.$description: The ink on the accent fill.

success.$description: Herb green: readable as status text on plaster.

warning.$description: Ochre amber: readable as status text on plaster.

error.$description: Cinnabar red: readable as status text on plaster.

info.$description: Cobalt glaze: readable as status text on plaster.

on-semantic-success.$description: The ink on the success fill.

on-semantic-warning.$description: The ink on the warning fill.

on-semantic-error.$description: The ink on the error fill.

on-semantic-info.$description: The ink on the info fill.

selected.$description: Espresso ink: the selected state fill.

on-selected.$description: Plaster base: the ink on the selected fill.

disabled.$description: Kiln dust: the fill a disabled control wears.

on-disabled.$description: Walnut ink on a disabled control's fill.

focus-ring.$description: Focus indicator follows the primary terracotta.

link.$description: Prose links follow the primary terracotta.
